claim: Internal length in the same US men's size 9 ranges from 255 to 281 mm across over 1000 lab-measured shoes
exact_words: Having measured the internal length of over 1000 shoes in our lab, we discovered that it can range from 255 to 281 mm in the same US size 9!

claim: Three ASICS shoes of the same size differ in internal length
exact_words: Different internal shoe length in three ASICS shoes of the same size (men's US 9)

claim: Mondopoint/CM sizes refer to insole length, at least 5 mm over the foot (RunRepeat's statement, not a measurement)
exact_words: They refer to the shoe's insole length (or internal length), which should be at least 5 mm larger than your actual foot length.

claim: adidas internal length at men's US 9 ranges 260.1 to 280.4 mm in RunRepeat's lab
exact_words: Even though we always measured the internal length of adidas shoes in the same men's US size 9, we've gotten a wild range of numbers, from 260.1 mm to 280.4 mm!

claim: Chuck 70 toebox narrower than the average sneaker (width, not length)
exact_words: Please note that the Chuck 70 silhouette has an extremely tapered toebox which is 8-10 mm narrower in the big toe area than the average sneaker!

claim: Some Timberland models run shorter or longer than the expected internal length
exact_words: Some models can run shorter or longer than the expected internal length, others can have more tapered toebox shapes.

claim: RunRepeat's note that internal length is not a great measure of fit
exact_words: Our testing shows that internal length is not a great measure of fit.

claim: Euro Hiker (internal length 257.9 mm at men's US 7.5) runs true to Timberland's chart
exact_words: Provided that there should be a few millimeters of extra space between your toes and the edge of the shoe, the Euro Hiker runs true to the Timberland footwear size chart.
